entity: Judge Rodney Gilstrap: cases assigned to him while he or his wife held a litigant's stock
what_we_add: the 183-case count for Apple, Microsoft, AT&T and Walmart specifically, over disclosure years 2010-20
why: WSJ and ABA Journal name Gilstrap as the judge with the most stock conflicts - 138 cases while he or his wife held an interest - same finding, same direction.
